scope: OutsideRail_V1 Update plus sampled-distance/extents/tolerance helpers; original-PC behavior and replacement-kernel equivalence untested

inputs.required: Outside curve must convert to NURBS or UpdateError(Missing Custom Rail)
inputs.radius: Try double; otherwise NURBS accurate bounding-box Max.Z; missing curve -> UpdateError(Missing Ring Rail)

preparation: Duplicate/to-NURBS/MakeDeformable. Sample50 normalized arc-length fractions i/50 excluding endpoint, using Curve.NormalizedLengthParameters at helper CSUtil.Tolerance. Take minimum sampled Euclidean origin distance, not exact closest-point distance. min==0/maxDouble or radius==0 -> error. Uniform origin scale radius/min.
extents: Intersect curve with finite origin rays to Z+100,Z-100,X+100,X-100. Helpers use first PointA without count guards; all four helper calls evaluated with bitwise &. These are axis-intersection extents, not bounding-box extrema.
unlocked: Three ordered transforms: stretch Z from bottom so top reaches radius+top; recompute extents; stretch Z from top so bottom reaches -radius-bottom; recompute; scale X by (radius+side)/right. The first two use a plane whose local Y is world Z. No lock-branch seam normalization is applied.
locked: Scale X, intersect finite horizontal segment[-200,200] at Z0 using application tolerance; require exactly2 events. Seam to first ParameterA, duplicate/reverse, closest-point and trim both halves at second PointA; select top by domain-mid Z. Scale top/bottom Z separately around origin; JoinCurves and take first if nonempty. Intersect positive-Z ray; use first parameter if present, otherwise closest point to (0,0,100). Set seam; reverse if start tangent dot X<0.
tolerances: CSBlockUtil.CSUtil.Tolerance is cached after first GetTolerance callback, fallback0.001 when no callback. Locked direct intersections use current Application.Tolerance; helper extents and normalized-length mapping use cached helper tolerance. Do not conflate the two policies.
outputs: Convert resulting curve through legacy OnNurbs form; emit CSOutsideRingRailData. oOutsideScale always emits numeric0, not the computed scale ratios.
requiredKernelOperations: NURBS duplication/deformability and nonuniform affine transforms
Finite curve-curve intersection with event ordering and tolerances
Accurate bounds, curve domain/mid/tangent and closest point
Closed-curve seam, reversal, trim and joining with output ordering
requiredOracleCases: Asymmetric/noncircular curve, min sampled vs exact distance, degenerate spans
Locked/unlocked branches, first-event ordering, join null/empty/multiple outputs
Zero/near-zero denominators, seam/tangent continuity and nonfinite transforms
Native output topology/parameterization and original-PC comparison
limit: Generic circle/box support cannot substitute for this algorithm. Source unchecked failure paths require original-runtime evidence before correction/emulation decisions.
